<section class="grignan-home">

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html,
body,
#quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.grignan-home {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.grignan-home * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE DE PAGE (HARMONISÉ AVEC AGIR)
===================================== */

.grignan-home .gh-page-header {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 58px 20px 38px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.comprendre-titre-filigrane {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 39%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 440px;
  max-width: 94vw;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.grignan-home .gh-kicker,
.grignan-home .gh-page-header h1,
.grignan-home .gh-page-header p {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.grignan-home .gh-kicker {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.grignan-home .gh-page-header h1 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(50px, 9vw, 76px);
  color: #2a9d8f;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

.grignan-home .gh-page-header p {
  font-size: 21px;
  color: #666;
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* =====================================
   TITRE DOSSIER (HARMONISÉ AVEC AGIR)
===================================== */

.grignan-home .gh-dossier-title {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 15px 0 38px;
}

.grignan-home .gh-dossier-title h2 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 30px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.grignan-home .gh-dossier-title p {
  font-size: 19px;
  color: #666;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* =====================================
   LISTE DES BOUTONS
===================================== */

.grignan-home .gh-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 10px 45px;
}

.grignan-home a.gh-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  border: 2px solid #2a9d8f;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform .22s, box-shadow .22s;
  float: none;
  position: relative;
}

.grignan-home a.gh-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

/* =====================================
   ICÔNES
===================================== */

.grignan-home .gh-item-icon {
  flex: 0 0 54px;
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 24px;
  color: white;
}

.grignan-home .contexte .gh-item-icon {
  background: #e07a3d;
}

.grignan-home .description .gh-item-icon {
  background: #7b2cbf;
}

.grignan-home .financements .gh-item-icon {
  background: #2a9d4a;
}

.grignan-home .juridiques .gh-item-icon {
  background: #8b5a2b;
}

.grignan-home .essentiel .gh-item-icon {
  background: #1a1a1a;
}

/* =====================================
   TEXTE DES BOUTONS
===================================== */

.grignan-home .gh-item-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  gap: 4px;
}

.grignan-home .gh-item-heading {
  display: block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #1a1a1a;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.grignan-home .gh-item-description {
  display: block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: normal;
  color: #666;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE (HARMONISÉ AVEC AGIR)
===================================== */

@media(max-width:600px) {

  .grignan-home .gh-page-header {
    padding: 36px 16px 30px;
  }

  .comprendre-titre-filigrane {
    width: 280px;
    opacity: 0.14;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-kicker {
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-page-header h1 {
    font-size: 45px;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-page-header p {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-dossier-title h2 {
    font-size: 25px;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-dossier-title p {
    font-size: 17px;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }

  .grignan-home a.gh-item {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-item-icon {
    flex-basis: 48px;
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .grignan-home .gh-item-heading {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .lavande-filigrane,
  .ble-filigrane,
  .comprendre-titre-filigrane {
    display: none;
  }

}
</style>
